verdict_basis: All digitized values accepted (within ~2 px of the verifier reading). Flag is documentation only: conditions.notes misattributes the Fig. 2e current density / trap pH to this run (see issues).
independence: Verifier extracted the embedded raster itself (pymupdf, native resolution), located tick marks with its own code, and re-read every value with its own reader (per-row nearest-prototype colour classification of two side strips per bar, error-bar green and white hatch excluded, monotone DP over the legend stacking order; markers by colour masks + morphological opening). Extractor scripts and readings were not used.

fixes_applied.change: meta.json conditions.notes: replaced 'volume_mL is the feed tank (50 mL, ...)' with a sentence consistent with volume_mL = null (feed volume not stated for this run; 50 mL is stated only for the Fig. 2e run) and dropped the duplicate closing 'Feed volume not stated' sentence; attributed the ~50 mA cm-2 (0.204 A) current and the pH 12.65 / 1.53 values to the Fig. 2e synthetic run and stated that no current is reported for the real-wastewater run. data/real regenerated (conditions.notes only; series unchanged).

Powered-window cut (coordinator request): the unchanged 0-300 min digitization was copied byte-identically to wpd_datasets_full_0-300min.csv, and wpd_datasets.csv now holds only t <= 180 min (4 of 6 sampling times, original values, nothing re-read), so the converted dataset matches potential_mode 'potentiostatic'. DC-off time established from the figure (no switch time in the text for this run): Fig. 3d labels 'DC on' and 'DC off' on either side of a dashed vertical line that sits midway between the 3 h and 4 h bars (pixel measurement on the native main-text image: x = 1843 px, 0.48 of the bar-centre gap), so the last DC-on sample is 3 h (180 min) and the switch fell between 3 and 4 h. Derived corroboration: the text's NO3- removal rate (436 +/- 18 g-N m-2 d-1) equals 31.1 mM x 50 mL removed over 180 min on 4 cm2. That fits the 3-h window if the feed was 50 mL as in the synthetic runs, but the feed volume is not stated for this run (it would be 83 mL for a 5-h normalization), so the rate does not confirm the window on its own. meta.json: conditions.notes records the window, the full-series path and how the DC-off time was established; provenance.figure notes the window; n_basis_note says no equivalent of the Fig. 2e 1.05 mmol check exists for this run (molar NH3 amount stated only for Fig. 2e); provenance.notes marks post-window statements as referring to the full file. data/real/gao2022_fig3d_cuo_realww.json regenerated: series, reported_n_loss and n_closure now end at 180 min.
